description: This file defines functions to support creating ONNX operators within the PyTorch FX graph, specifically for export to ONNX format. It includes symbolic representations of ONNX operators, mapping between PyTorch and ONNX data types, and specific ONNX operator implementations related to attention mechanisms and rotary embeddings.

methods.name: dict[torch._ops.OpOverload,Callable] aten_decompositions()
methods.description: Returns the ONNX to ATen decomposition table.

methods.name: tuple[str,str] _parse_domain_op_type(domain_op: str)
methods.description: Parses a domain and operation type from a string formatted as 'domain::op_type' or 'op_type'.

methods.name: torch.Tensor symbolic( domain_op: str, /, inputs: Sequence[torch.Tensor | None], attrs: dict[ str, int | float | str | bool | Sequence[int] | Sequence[float] | Sequence[str] | Sequence[bool], ] | None = None, *, dtype: torch.dtype | int, shape: Sequence[int | torch.SymInt], version: int | None = None, metadata_props: dict[str, str] | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a symbolic FX operator for an arbitrary ONNX operator, supporting a single output.

methods.name: Sequence[torch.Tensor] symbolic_multi_out( domain_op: str, /, inputs: Sequence[torch.Tensor | None], attrs: dict[ str, int | float | str | bool | Sequence[int] | Sequence[float] | Sequence[str] | Sequence[bool], ] | None = None, *, dtypes: Sequence[torch.dtype | int], shapes: Sequence[Sequence[int | torch.SymInt]], version: int | None = None, metadata_props: dict[str, str] | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a symbolic FX operator with multiple outputs for an arbitrary ONNX operator.

methods.name: torch.Tensor rotary_embedding( X: torch.Tensor, cos_cache: torch.Tensor, sin_cache: torch.Tensor, position_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None, *, interleaved: bool = False, num_heads: int = 0, rotary_embedding_dim: int = 0, )
methods.description: Implements the RotaryEmbedding operator in ONNX, modeling rotary positional embeddings.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor] attention( Q: torch.Tensor, K: torch.Tensor, V: torch.Tensor, attn_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None, past_key: torch.Tensor | None = None, past_value: torch.Tensor | None = None, *, is_causal: bool = False, kv_num_heads: int = 0, q_num_heads: int = 0, qk_matmul_output_mode: int = 0, scale: float | None = None, softcap: float = 0.0, softmax_precision: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Implements the Attention operator in ONNX, computing scaled dot-product attention with support for various attention mechanisms.
